participation.context: Read the epistle standing, and did not claim the cousin.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: a reading he did not answer at the stall

story.body: The line in Daniel stood as your copy had it. You read the epistle of Saint Peters Complaint standing, and copied no stanza.

relations.note: a reading he did not answer at the stall

title: Checked Daniel and read the epistle of Saint Peters Complaint

participation.context: Held the book. The picture has the hands and not the face.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the book, open, and not yet bought in this moment

story.body: The epistle and the two hands are what the picture holds. Your face is not in it.

relations.note: the book, open, and not yet bought in this moment

title: Left a picture of the epistle in both hands

relations.note: a purchase with no word in it

story.body: You put the coin down and did not answer. The book went inside the doublet.

relations.note: a purchase with no word in it

title: Paid sixpence for the thin book

description: A rule, and nothing under it

participation.context: Copied the sentence, ruled the line, and wrote nothing under it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: The rule kept his words on their own side. Your side of the leaf stayed empty.

title: Copied the sentence and ruled a line under it

participation.context: Sat, and wrote the opening, and did not pace.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You did not walk the room. The lines that had been three words started, and you stayed in the chair.

title: Sat and wrote the two lines on the death of kings

relations.note: the middle of the speech, unwalked

story.body: The speech went on inside the crown. You did not get up to test it on the floor.

relations.note: the middle of the speech, unwalked

title: Wrote the hollow crown and the little pin while sitting

participation.context: Wrote the coming down, and ended the leaf there.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: Flint, and a king coming down

story.body: The page went from the speech to the wall without a break. The leaf ends while he is still coming down.

relations.note: Flint, and a king coming down

title: Wrote Flint and a king coming down

description: One candle, and a second guttered

participation.context: Left the picture to the desk.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the knife is the penknife, and the page is the night's work

story.body: The candle, the page, the knife, and the guttered candle are what the picture holds. You are not in it as a face.

relations.note: the knife is the penknife, and the page is the night's work

title: Left a picture of the candle, the page, and the knife

participation.context: Spoke the boast, refused it, and went to bed.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: a sentence he will not let stand

story.body: You heard yourself praise the year and you stopped the sentence. The page stayed as it was.

relations.note: a sentence he will not let stand

title: Stopped the praise and slept at home
